limits: Bounded completion checkpoints use god mode, accelerated combat and walking, a high interaction-skill fixture, selected original VM roots and declared prior chapter state; they are not a continuous no-cheat playthrough or proof of pathfinding/combat balance.
Opening tutorial presentation and optional tutorial subobjective sequence are not measured.
The optional boar-luring aid for the wolf encounter is not replayed; white-wolf death and loot completion are tested.
Smith-first totem reporting is exercised; the equivalent Goblin-first order is not independently replayed.
Selected real exit controls and destination loads are exercised. The full map matrix prepares gates and records final load requests; it does not earn every gate or load every destination.
Every named quest and installed side archive has a completion fixture. The declared branch matrix is not every informational dialogue, party permutation or simultaneously active quest combination.
The final companion branch uses previously hired merc7. Gipat and Ingos farewell variants are listed separately.
Only the four independently captured native references constitute original-executable comparisons; source-derived assertions and existing compatibility repairs do not.
Rendering, cinematics, sound, co-op, other platforms and arbitrary legacy/mod player saves are outside this qualification.
Validation is selected from immutable completed case reports. Incomplete and failed developmental runs remain retained and are not represented as passing suites.
